# `aitbc analytics optimize`

Get optimization recommendations for one chain or all chains.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc analytics optimize [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Specific chain ID for recommendations |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc analytics optimize
```
